item.title: Dam Removal Reopens Habitat: Virginia project reconnects 127 miles; migratory fish return upstream
item.description: In 2014, the removal of Harvell Dam revitalized over 120 miles of river, providing essential upstream habitats for migratory fish. Observations from state biologists and anglers confirmed fish migrating upstream post-demolition. This collaborative restoration project united various agencies and organizations, successfully restoring the river's free-flowing state and enhancing benefits for both aquatic life and recreational activities. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Suborno Isaac Bari, a 12-year-old student, graduated high school after skipping several grades. He began attending university-level classes and lecturing in India at age seven. Bari entered New York University with plans to complete his degree by age 14. His parents, both educators, inspired his ambition to teach mathematics and physics.
